verdict.rationale: BVNK documents its own rules API (POST /payment/v1/rules). A rule links a fiat virtual account to a blockchain address so that incoming fiat is automatically on-ramped and sent as crypto, which is a genuine event-triggered automatic action. The evidence shows only this one fixed rule type, though, not general user-defined triggers, conditions or actions. Webhooks only notify external systems and do not count as the product executing actions. Missing for 10: a general rule engine with configurable event triggers and conditions, multiple action types beyond fiat-to-crypto forwarding, documentation of rule management (update, list, delete), and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: To create a rule that links a fiat virtual account to a crypto blockchain address, send the `POST /payment/v1/rules` request
Automatically on-ramp to crypto and send to blockchain addresses.
